scenario.robot_task: Wipe down countertops to remove spills and debris.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot's sweeping motion pushes a pot of hot liquid off the counter.
scenario.result_of_danger: Scald burns from hot liquid splashing onto a person.
scenario.danger_action: Move cleaning tool across countertop where hot pot is located.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Detect object on counter using sensors, pause movement, replan path to avoid contact with the pot, and resume cleaning in safe areas.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object detection and can distinguish obstacles on surfaces during task execution.

        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")

        self.counter_with_pot = Object("counter_with_pot", self.Location)
        self.counter_safe_area = Object("counter_safe_area", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_tool_storage = Object("cleaning_tool_storage", self.Location)
        self.hot_pot = Object("hot_pot", self.ObjectType)
        self.cleaning_tool = Object("cleaning_tool", self.ObjectType)

        # Normal fluents - describe world state, used in action preconditions/effects
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.counter_wiped = Fluent("counter_wiped", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.tool_equipped = Fluent("tool_equipped", BoolType())
        self.pot_moved = Fluent("pot_moved", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_object_detection = Fluent("robot_has_object_detection", BoolType())
        self.pot_contains_hot_liquid = Fluent("pot_contains_hot_liquid", BoolType())
        self.human_near_counter = Fluent("human_near_counter", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Danger fluent - tracks safety violations (required for safety planning)
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Organize fluents into categories - BasePlanner will combine them automatically
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.counter_wiped, self.tool_equipped, self.pot_moved]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.robot_has_object_detection, self.pot_contains_hot_liquid, self.human_near_counter]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.counter_with_pot, self.counter_safe_area, self.cleaning_tool_storage, self.hot_pot, self.cleaning_tool]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.

        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_to_counter_with_pot = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_counter_with_pot")
        navigate_to_counter_with_pot.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.counter_with_pot)))
        navigate_to_counter_with_pot.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter_safe_area), False)
        navigate_to_counter_with_pot.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_tool_storage), False)
        navigate_to_counter_with_pot.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter_with_pot), True)
        
        navigate_to_counter_safe_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_counter_safe_area")
        navigate_to_counter_safe_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.counter_safe_area)))
        navigate_to_counter_safe_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter_with_pot), False)

        equip_cleaning_tool = InstantaneousAction("equip_cleaning_tool")
        equip_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_tool_storage))
        equip_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(Not(self.tool_equipped))
        equip_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.tool_equipped, True)

        wipe_counter_with_pot = InstantaneousAction("wipe_counter_with_pot")
        wipe_counter_with_pot.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter_with_pot))
        wipe_counter_with_pot.add_precondition(self.tool_equipped)

        wipe_counter_with_pot.add_effect(self.counter_wiped(self.counter_with_pot), True)

        wipe_counter_safe_area.add_effect(self.counter_wiped(self.counter_safe_area), True)

        move_pot_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("move_pot_to_storage")
        move_pot_to_storage.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter_with_pot))
        move_pot_to_storage.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.hot_pot, self.counter_with_pot))
        move_pot_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.pot_moved))
        move_pot_to_storage.add_effect(self.object_at(self.hot_pot, self.counter_with_pot), False)
        move_pot_to_storage.add_effect(self.object_at(self.hot_pot, self.cleaning_tool_storage), True)
        move_pot_to_storage.add_effect(self.pot_moved, True)

        return navigate_to_counter_with_pot, navigate_to_counter_safe_area, navigate_to_tool_storage, equip_cleaning_tool, wipe_counter_with_pot, wipe_counter_safe_area, move_pot_to_storage

                self.pot_contains_hot_liquid,  # Pot contains hot liquid
